summary: Fix duplicate 'ou' divider on /auth/login validated. Static grep confirms 1 styles.dividerTxt occurrence. Runtime test (after Metro restart to clear bundler cache) shows exactly 1 visible 'ou' divider between 'Se connecter' and 'Créer un compte'. login-go-register, login-forgot-password, login-submit-btn, login-email-input, login-password-input all visible. Full login flow with test@wedding.fr/test1234 succeeds → redirect to /home.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: initial UI test showed 2 dividers due to stale Metro bundle cache; after `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`, only 1 rendered. Main agent should be aware that hot-reload sometimes doesn't pick up conditional removals — full Expo restart was required to confirm the fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login screen on web renders exactly 1 'ou' divider. Source line 121 in /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx is the only one, inside !IS_IOS_NATIVE conditional. If a future testing agent sees 2 dividers, restart expo to clear Metro cache before reporting bug.
rca_of_issue: Iteration_6 reported duplicate divider. Root cause was a second hardcoded divider block outside the !IS_IOS_NATIVE conditional. Fix removed it cleanly. Verified via grep (1 dividerTxt match) + runtime DOM inspection (1 visible 'ou' text node).
